source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The world-map travelling song: adventurous and wide open, a sense of walking across green hills toward a far horizon, confident but not bombastic. A heroic horn and flute melody over a bright marching rhythm. Tempo 112 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D major. Instrumentation: french horns and flute lead, pizzicato and bowed strings, marching snare, light timpani, warm string pads, harp runs. Form: short 2-bar pickup, verse melody, a soaring bridge, return to the verse. Duration: 100 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
